name: What is a backflow preventer and do I need one for my outdoor kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What is a backflow preventer and do I need one for my outdoor kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: A backflow preventer is a device installed in your plumbing system to stop contaminated water from flowing backward into your clean water supply. For outdoor kitchens, a backflow preventer is often a regulatory requirement to safeguard your potable water from potential contaminants that could enter the system through an outdoor faucet or hose connection. This is a critical safety component. We ensure all outdoor kitchen plumbing installations meet local backflow prevention codes to protect your household's water quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: A backflow preventer stops contaminated water from entering your clean water supply and is often required for outdoor kitchens to meet safety codes.
